summary: BHP Group Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 28 August 2026, furnishing an exchange release announcing the currency exchange rate for its final dividend of 99 US cents per share for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026. The release specifies the South African Rand exchange rate of 15.96480, resulting in a gross dividend of 1,580.51520 South African cents per share, with dividend tax withholding of 20% for South African branch register shareholders. The record date is 4 September 2026 and payment date is 23 September 2026. This is a routine dividend notification with no special-situation elements, so no category applies.
